current_snapshot_note: This version reports the historical 15-study selection under the 4.0 cutoff. No new studies, selection rerun, altered MMAT judgments or changed eligibility rules are incorporated. The cutoff was not validated against eligibility and the appraisal remains preliminary.
prisma_reporting: The historical selection retains 15 empirical studies under the unchanged 4.0 cutoff. The current source-retrieval overlay records 17 reports sought, two without a verifiable copy (Sokkhey and Zeng), 15 assessed at full text, one protocol excluded, and 14 recovered empirical reports. Sokkhey remains a historical inclusion without a verifiable copy. Machine2019_007 remains excluded after abstract screening. No search, selection, corpus, or MMAT judgment was reprocessed.

data_reconciliation.interpretation: The original sensitivity-review denominators and findings remain recorded. Confirmed duplicate reports are removed before screening and the two corrected years move records to temporal screening exclusions. These corrections do not change the 15-study historical selection or the 4.0 cutoff. No new studies or selection rerun are incorporated.

current_source_retrieval.interpretation: This current source-retrieval overlay does not reapply selection or change the historical 15-study selection. Two reports (Sokkhey and Zeng) have no verifiable copy; 15 reports were assessed, the Imperatrice protocol was excluded, and 14 empirical reports have recovered text. Sokkhey remains only as a historical inclusion with its previous MMAT responses, not as a text verified in this review. Machine2019_007 remains the abstract-stage exclusion.

applied_rule: The protocol and scoring function use a nominal 0-10 range; preserved values range from 0.0 to 4.5 without renormalization. The operational comparison score >= 4.0 retained candidates for further eligibility consideration, subject to other criteria. The cutoff was not used only to order reading and is not a quality score or percentage.
threshold_calibration: No empirical calibration or comparison of cutoffs documenting why exactly 4.0 was originally selected was found in the protocol, scoring code and preserved records.
